entries.title: Genesis 6:1
segments: ¶And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,

words.text: ¶And it came to pass, when men

entries.title: Genesis 6:2
segments: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they [were] fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

entries.title: Genesis 6:3
segments: ¶And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also [is] flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

entries.title: Genesis 6:4
segments: ¶There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare [children] to them, the same [became] mighty men which [were] of old, men of renown.

entries.title: Genesis 6:5
segments: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man [was] great in the earth, and [that] every imagination of the thoughts of his heart [was] only evil continually. {every...: or, the whole imagination: the Hebrew word signifieth not only the imagination, but also the purposes and desires} {continually: Heb. every day}

entries.title: Genesis 6:6
segments: ¶And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.

entries.title: Genesis 6:7
segments: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them. {both...: Heb. from man unto beast}

words.text: them. {both...: Heb. from man unto beast}

entries.title: Genesis 6:8
segments: ¶But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 6:9
segments: These [are] the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man [and] perfect in his generations, [and] Noah walked with God. {perfect: or, upright}

entries.title: Genesis 6:10
segments: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

entries.title: Genesis 6:11
segments: ¶The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

entries.title: Genesis 6:12
segments: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 6:13
segments: ¶And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth. {with the earth: or, from the earth}

words.text: . {with the earth: or, from the earth}

entries.title: Genesis 6:14
segments: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch. {rooms: Heb. nests}

entries.title: Genesis 6:15
segments: And this [is the fashion] which thou shalt make it [of]: The length of the ark [shall be] three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.

words.text: And this [is the fashion] which thou shalt make

entries.title: Genesis 6:16
segments: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; [with] lower, second, and third [stories] shalt thou make it.

entries.title: Genesis 6:17
segments: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein [is] the breath of life, from under heaven; [and] every thing that [is] in the earth shall die.

entries.title: Genesis 6:18
segments: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.

words.text: But with thee will I establish

entries.title: Genesis 6:19
segments: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every [sort] shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep [them] alive with thee; they shall be male and female.

words.text: with thee; they shall be male

entries.title: Genesis 6:20
segments: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every [sort] shall come unto thee, to keep [them] alive.

entries.title: Genesis 6:21
segments: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather [it] to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.

entries.title: Genesis 6:22
segments: ¶Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.
